title: Review squad
summary: A squad review MUST gather findings through one parallel agent per review dimension, and the reviewer MUST join them into one ranked set before it applies REVIEW-001.
instructions: The reviewer MUST capture the review target once and MUST give every dimension agent that same captured diff.
The reviewer MUST write an intent brief covering what the change does, why, and which follow-ups the plan defers, then MUST give it to every dimension agent.

The reviewer MUST state the resolved lineup, including which conditional dimensions activated and which the change skipped, and MUST NOT drop a stated dimension silently. A charter whose agent cannot start MUST run in the reviewer context instead.
A dimension agent MUST return findings only and MUST NOT edit any file. Bounded remediation stays with the reviewer under REVIEW-001.
The reviewer MUST merge duplicate findings, drop what the intent brief already answers, rank the remainder, and record each dropped finding with its reason.
A dimension that returns nothing MUST appear in the review artifact as empty rather than absent, and a finding that touches credentials, data loss, or an authorization bypass MUST rank first.
The referenced `library/skills/review-squad.md` guidance MUST govern the lineup, the charters, the finding shape, and the calibration bar for this review.

guidance_sources.read_trigger: Read this guidance before you start a squad review or join its findings.
